summary: IsoEnergy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a definitive agreement with DISA Technologies to form DISA Uranium Corporation, a new U.S. uranium company. IsoEnergy contributes its Utah uranium mine portfolio in exchange for 1,677,350 shares, retaining ~33% ownership on a fully diluted basis. DISA Uranium secured US$105 million in financing commitments from strategic investors, with IsoEnergy participating for US$33 million; implied pro forma equity value is ~US$505 million. The transaction combines IsoEnergy's assets with DISA's HPSA processing technology and remediation business. No board recommendation or advisors named. Watch for regulatory approvals and closing conditions; risk-arb focuses on financing completion and ownership structure.
